## Target

Restore the information erased by worst-case conditioning: determine how many
full center-curvature defects are necessarily carried by the Stage 10 local
frustration and whether the resulting center contours are summable.

## Decision

The Stage 10 frustrating conditioning is not free even in its exact center
realization: it necessarily belongs to a contour with at least five negative
plaquettes.  Center-sector contours are summable below an explicit
volume-independent activity threshold.
